Opening fraction-side/count/allow-zero conversion and saved one-star normalization remain distinct, as recorded. Left-held numerical drags survive an additional Right press/release within the widget. Chord presses retain Qt Left priority; right-only drag and hover after Left release remain inert. Cross-edge chord capture remains a documented framework limitation.
